rca.rootCause: In pydicom/filewriter.py, the VR-to-writer dispatch maps VR 'OF' (Other Float) to write_numbers, which expects numeric scalar/list values. OF should be treated as a raw byte string (like OB/OW), so it must be dispatched to write_OBvalue/write_OWvalue instead. When FloatPixelData (VR OF) is set to bytes, write_numbers fails because bytes has no append attribute and pack cannot convert bytes to float.
evidence: Issue traceback shows write_data_element dispatches to write_numbers for VR OF, causing 'AttributeError: bytes object has no attribute append' and 'struct.error: required argument is not a float'
Issue reporter states: 'Error in filewriter using write_numbers instead of write_OBvalue/write_OWvalue. Looks like it's been wrong since 2008.'
The failing data element is (7fe0, 0008) Float Pixel Data OF: b'\x00\x00\x00\x00', confirming OF holds raw bytes not numeric values
Repo map shows pydicom/filewriter.py contains the writer dispatch logic and write_numbers/write_OBvalue/write_OWvalue functions
